Name: Auto Toggle Placement Preview
Author: AstralFSK
Description:
Yet another QOL mod for placements.

When you are holding water can, a scarecrow or a sprinker, all of the already placed scarecrows/sprinkers ranges or watered tiles will be shown. The preview for the holding scarecrow/sprinker will also be shown.

- Now also support bombs' range, but unfortunately due to some limitations, I can't make placed bombs show their range, so we are stuck with unplaced preview.

Manifest.Name: Auto Toggle Placement Preview
Manifest.Description: Auto toggle the corresponding placement preview for the chosen tools
